title.en: Do you do what customers say, or what they will want?
title.zh: 做顾客说的，还是做顾客将来要的？

description.en: From a failed glue that became the Post-it to the difference between customer-led and market-oriented firms, and how a firm can shape its market, with Coles.
description.zh: 从一种失败的胶水变成便利贴说起，讲清“顾客牵着走”和“市场导向”的区别，以及企业怎样塑造市场，案例是 Coles。

description.en: doing what customers ask for is what market orientation means
description.zh: 照顾客说的做，就是市场导向

description.en: market orientation means more marketing activity
description.zh: 市场导向就是多做营销

text.en: In 1968 a scientist at 3M tried to make a super-strong adhesive and failed. What he made was weak, and it could be peeled off and used again. A colleague used it as a page marker in his church hymn book. 3M kept developing it. We now know it as the **Post-it note**.
text.zh: 1968 年，3M 的一位科学家想做一种超强胶，没成功。做出来的胶很弱，但能撕下来再用。一位同事拿它在教堂的赞美诗集里当书签。3M 继续开发它，就是我们今天的**便利贴**。

text.en: Suppose 3M had surveyed office workers in 1968 and asked, “What adhesive do you want?” Nobody would have asked for a sticky note, because nobody knew it was possible. **So is listening to customers the wrong thing to do?**
text.zh: 假设 3M 在 1968 年调研办公室职员：“你们想要什么胶？”没有人会要便利贴，因为没人知道它可能存在。**那么，听顾客的话是错的吗？**

prompt.en: A firm only ever does what its customers say they want. What is the most likely result?
prompt.zh: 一家企业永远只做顾客明说想要的东西。最可能的结果是什么？

label.en: Happy customers today, but it is beaten later by a firm that found a need nobody had named
label.zh: 今天顾客满意，但以后被发现了没人说过的需求的企业打败

label.en: Faster growth than anyone else, because it never misses
label.zh: 增长比谁都快，因为从不出错

feedback.en: Customers can only describe the world they know. Following them is safe in the short run and blind in the long run.
feedback.zh: 顾客只能描述他们熟悉的世界。跟着他们，短期安全，长期是盲的。

label.en: Nothing: customers always know what they need
label.zh: 没什么影响：顾客总是知道自己需要什么

feedback.en: The sticky note shows they often do not.
feedback.zh: 便利贴恰恰说明他们常常不知道。

label.en: It lowers its costs
label.zh: 成本降低

feedback.en: Nothing in following requests lowers cost.
feedback.zh: 照着要求做，并不会降低成本。

explain.en: Being led by customers keeps you where they already are. The better aim is a firm that **senses what is not yet said**. Sort these behaviours to feel the difference.
explain.zh: 被顾客牵着走，只会让你停在他们现在的位置。更好的目标是**感知还没说出口的需求**。把下面这些行为分一分，感受区别。

title.en: Whose hand is on the wheel?

text.en: Six behaviours, made up as illustrations: none is a fact about a real company.
text.zh: 六种行为，都是为说明而编的，不是哪家真实公司的事实。

alt.en: Six behaviours to tag as customer-led or market-oriented.
alt.zh: 六种行为，标为“顾客牵着走”或“市场导向”。

label.en: Customer-led
label.zh: 顾客牵着走

label.en: Market-oriented
label.zh: 市场导向

text.en: A survey after each delivery; the firm fixes the complaints that come up most. (an illustration)
text.zh: 每次送货后发问卷，企业修复被投诉最多的问题。（举例）

why.en: It answers what customers have already said: expressed wants, a short-term fix, learning by survey.
why.zh: 它回应的是顾客已经说出的：明说的需求、短期修补、靠问卷学习。

text.en: A team watches shoppers use a prototype and spots a difficulty none of them mentioned. (an illustration)
text.zh: 团队观察购物者使用原型，发现了没人提过的困难。（举例）

why.en: It goes after a latent need: one the customer cannot yet put into words.
why.zh: 它追的是潜在需求：顾客自己还说不出来的需求。

text.en: The firm sets this quarter’s target as a higher satisfaction score. (an illustration)
text.zh: 企业把本季度目标定为更高的满意度得分。（举例）

why.en: Short-term focus, goal is satisfaction rather than a new kind of value.
why.zh: 短期导向，目标是满意度，而不是新型价值。

text.en: The firm works with a few lead users who are years ahead of the market. (an illustration)
text.zh: 企业和几位领先好几年的先锋用户合作。（举例）

why.en: Lead users and experiments are the learning process of a market-oriented firm.
why.zh: 先锋用户和实验，是市场导向企业的学习方式。

text.en: Staff may test ideas that could make today’s best seller obsolete. (an illustration)
text.zh: 员工可以测试可能让今天的畅销品过时的想法。（举例）

why.en: Generative, proactive learning: willing to cannibalise to create more customer value.
why.zh: 生成式、主动的学习：愿意自我淘汰，创造更多顾客价值。

text.en: Every feature request from the biggest customers goes straight to the product plan. (an illustration)
text.zh: 最大客户提的每个功能需求，都直接进产品计划。（举例）

why.en: Responsive and adaptive: it follows what customers ask for.
why.zh: 响应式、适应式：跟着顾客的要求走。

done.en: Customer-led: **expressed wants, responsive, short-term, satisfaction, adaptive learning by surveys**. Market-oriented: **latent needs, proactive, long-term, customer value, generative learning by lead users and experiments**.
done.zh: 顾客牵着走：**明说的需求、响应式、短期、满意度、靠问卷的适应式学习**。市场导向：**潜在需求、主动式、长期、顾客价值、靠先锋用户和实验的生成式学习**。

text.en: A firm can be **market-driven** (it takes the market structure as given and behaviour as something to follow) or **drive markets** (it reshapes the value chain). Three ways to drive a market. Sort the moves.
text.zh: 企业可以是**市场驱动**（把市场结构当作给定，把行为当作要跟随的东西），也可以**驱动市场**（重塑价值链）。驱动市场有三种方式。把下面的做法分一分。

alt.en: Six moves to place under deconstruction, construction or functional modification.
alt.zh: 六种做法，放到解构、建构、功能调整下。

label.en: Deconstruction: remove a player
label.zh: 解构：拿掉一个环节

label.en: Construction: add a player
label.zh: 建构：加入一个环节

label.en: Functional modification: move a task
label.zh: 功能调整：把任务换个人做

label.en: A brand sells straight to customers, with no shop in between
label.zh: 品牌不经门店，直接卖给顾客

why.en: The retailer is taken out of the chain.
why.zh: 零售商被从链条里拿掉了。

label.en: A bank closes branches and serves everyone by app
label.zh: 银行关掉网点，全部改用 App 服务

label.en: A supermarket adds a delivery app partner between itself and the shopper
label.zh: 超市在自己和购物者之间加入一家送货 App 伙伴

why.en: A new player joins the chain (Coles expanded its Uber Eats partnership in FY26).
why.zh: 链条里多了一个新角色（Coles 在 2026 财年扩大了与 Uber Eats 的合作）。

label.en: A manufacturer opens a marketplace that brings buyers and small sellers together
label.zh: 制造商开设平台，把买家和小卖家撮合起来

label.en: Shoppers scan and bag their own items at a self-checkout
label.zh: 购物者在自助结账机上自己扫码、装袋

why.en: The task of scanning moves from staff to customer.
why.zh: 扫码这件事从员工转给了顾客。

label.en: A franchisor stops doing local marketing and leaves it to franchisees
label.zh: 特许方不再做本地营销，交给加盟商

why.en: The same function, a different party doing it.
why.zh: 功能不变，换了一方来做。

done.en: **Deconstruction** removes players, **construction** adds them, **functional modification** moves tasks between the players. Each changes who earns what and how value reaches the customer.
done.zh: **解构**拿掉环节，**建构**加入环节，**功能调整**在各方之间转移任务。每一种都改变谁赚什么、价值怎样到达顾客。

title.en: The framework, as the marker wants it

text.en: **Market orientation** is the organisation-wide gathering of information about customers, competitors and other market players (such as suppliers), sharing it across functions, and acting on it together to deliver superior customer value. Evidence from many studies links it to innovation, and through innovation to customer loyalty, quality and performance.
text.zh: **市场导向**是全组织去收集关于顾客、竞争对手和其他市场参与者（如供应商）的信息，在各职能间共享，并协同行动，以交付更高的顾客价值。大量研究把它和创新联系起来，再通过创新联系到顾客忠诚、质量和业绩。

text.en: Market orientation has a **responsive** side (monitoring commitment to customer needs, measuring satisfaction) and a **proactive** side (discovering needs customers are unaware of, working with lead users, even risking your own products becoming obsolete). A firm needs both; being only responsive is being customer-led.
text.zh: 市场导向有**响应**的一面（监测对顾客需求的投入、测量满意度）和**主动**的一面（发现顾客没意识到的需求、与先锋用户合作、甚至冒着自己的产品被淘汰的风险）。两者都需要；只有响应，就是被顾客牵着走。

items.en: **Market sensing**: gather and interpret what is happening in the market
items.zh: **市场感知**：收集并解读市场上正在发生什么

items.en: **Customer linking**: build close, lasting relationships with customers
items.zh: **顾客联结**：和顾客建立紧密、持久的关系

items.en: **Channel bonding**: tie the partners who reach customers into the same direction
items.zh: **渠道绑定**：把触达顾客的伙伴绑到同一方向上

text.en: Doing this needs **agility**: renewing and adapting quickly in a changing environment, which paradoxically needs stability (explore new things and exploit what works). Change comes as **adaptive** change (small, incremental, as needs evolve) or **transformative** change (large, in mission, strategy, structure and processes). A change programme moves from understanding the need for change, through building commitment and shaping the vision, to implementing and checking progress.
text.zh: 这需要**敏捷**：在变化的环境里快速更新与调整，而这反过来需要稳定（探索新东西，同时利用已有的长处）。变化有两种：**适应式**变化（小、渐进，随需求演变）和**转型式**变化（大，涉及使命、战略、结构和流程）。一个变革项目从认识到需要改变，经过建立承诺、塑造愿景，到实施并检查进展。

prompt.en: Coles is a market-oriented firm only if it does more than answer complaints. Using Coles’ FY26 facts (about 10.3 million active Flybuys members; online sales up 26.4%; same-day delivery; more exclusive partnerships such as M&S, Grill’d and Gami), write four sentences: **one** sensing or linking move, with its fact and *because*, and **one** way Coles may be only customer-led.
prompt.zh: Coles 只有做得比回应投诉更多，才算市场导向。用 Coles 2026 财年的事实（约 1,030 万活跃 Flybuys 会员；线上销售增长 26.4%；当日送达；与 M&S、Grill’d、Gami 等更多独家合作），写四句话：**一个**感知或联结的举措，配事实和“因为”；再写 Coles **可能只是顾客牵着走**的一处。

key_points.en: Uses a true Coles fact (Flybuys members, online growth, same-day delivery or exclusive partnerships)
key_points.zh: 用了一条真实的 Coles 事实

key_points.en: Links it to sensing or linking (information gathered about customers, or a lasting tie to them) with a because
key_points.zh: 把它联系到感知或联结，并有“因为”

key_points.en: Separates responsive from proactive: e.g. loyalty data shows what customers already buy, a latent need would need experiments
key_points.zh: 区分响应与主动：比如积分数据只显示顾客已买的，潜在需求需要实验

key_points.en: Marks its own reading as a reading, not a fact about Coles’ intent
key_points.zh: 把自己的解读当作解读，而不是 Coles 意图的事实

model_answer.en: Flybuys gives Coles information on what about 10.3 million active members already buy, which is market sensing and customer linking, because every purchase becomes data and a reason to stay in the programme. Coles’ move to same-day delivery from its own fulfilment centres, with online sales up 26.4% in FY26, can be read as sensing that time is the shopper’s scarce resource. But Flybuys data records expressed behaviour, so on its own it is customer-led: finding a need shoppers cannot yet name, like the sticky note, would need experiments such as the new exclusive ranges with partners, which this is my reading rather than a fact about Coles’ intent.
model_answer.zh: Flybuys 让 Coles 掌握约 1,030 万活跃会员已经在买什么，这是市场感知和顾客联结，因为每一笔购买都成为数据，也是留在计划里的理由。Coles 用自有履约中心做当日送达，2026 财年线上销售增长 26.4%，可以解读为感知到时间是购物者最稀缺的资源。但 Flybuys 数据记录的是已表达的行为，单靠它仍是顾客牵着走：要找到购物者还说不出的需求，就像便利贴，需要实验，例如与伙伴合作的新独家系列。这是我的解读，不是关于 Coles 意图的事实。

explain.en: Mark a reading as a reading: the examiner rewards the reasoning, not a claim about what the company thinks.
explain.zh: 把解读标成解读：阅卷人奖励的是推理，而不是对公司想法的断言。

prompt.en: A company adds every feature its biggest customers request and reports rising satisfaction. How would you describe it?
prompt.zh: 一家企业把最大客户提的每个功能都加上，满意度也在上升。你怎么描述它？

label.en: Customer-led: responsive to expressed wants, short-term, may miss latent needs
label.zh: 顾客牵着走：响应明说的需求、短期、可能错过潜在需求

label.en: Market-oriented: it listens to customers
label.zh: 市场导向：它在听顾客的

feedback.en: Listening is half of it; market orientation also scouts latent needs and competitors and acts proactively.
feedback.zh: 听只是一半；市场导向还要探查潜在需求和竞争对手，并主动行动。

label.en: Transformative change
label.zh: 转型式变革

feedback.en: Adding features is adaptive, incremental change.
feedback.zh: 加功能是适应式、渐进的变化。

explain.en: Customer-led is not wrong, it is incomplete.
explain.zh: 顾客牵着走不是错，而是不完整。

prompt.en: From lesson 1: Who Gives a Crap’s buyer who pays more is doing what?
prompt.zh: 来自第 1 课：愿意为 Who Gives a Crap 多花钱的买家，在做什么？

label.en: Judging value from what they get (symbolic, functional) against what they give up
label.zh: 按所得（象征、功能）对照所付来判断价值

label.en: Being irrational about price
label.zh: 对价格不理性

feedback.en: Value is relative to the customer; this buyer values the symbol.
feedback.zh: 价值相对于顾客；这个买家看重的是象征价值。

prompt.en: From lesson 1: which type of value is lowered by a returns policy?
prompt.zh: 来自第 1 课：退货政策降低的是哪类价值？

label.en: Cost or sacrifice value: it reduces risk and effort
label.zh: 成本/付出价值：降低风险和精力

label.en: Symbolic value
label.zh: 象征价值

feedback.en: A returns policy does not carry meaning; it reduces what the buyer risks.
feedback.zh: 退货政策不承载意义，它降低的是买家的风险。

explain.en: Costs are more than price: time, effort and risk count.
explain.zh: 成本不只是价格：时间、精力、风险都算。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain the difference between a customer-led and a market-oriented firm. (b) Using Coles in Australia, analyse how far it is market-oriented. (c) Make two recommendations.

Explain (5 marks). Exceeds: precise, thorough, clear, with the right terms. Meets: accurate, key points present, a little shallow.

Write the **Explain** part.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释“顾客牵着走”和“市场导向”企业的区别。(b) 以澳大利亚的 Coles 为例，分析它在多大程度上是市场导向。(c) 给出两条建议。

解释（5 分）。优秀：精确、完整、清楚，用对术语。达标：准确、要点齐全，但深度略浅。

写**解释**部分。

key_points.en: Defines market orientation as gathering and sharing information on customers, competitors and others and acting on it to deliver superior customer value
key_points.zh: 把市场导向定义为收集并共享顾客、竞争对手等信息并据此行动以交付更高顾客价值

key_points.en: Customer-led means expressed wants, responsive, short-term, satisfaction
key_points.zh: 顾客牵着走：明说需求、响应、短期、满意度

key_points.en: Market-oriented means latent needs, proactive, long-term, customer value, generative learning
key_points.zh: 市场导向：潜在需求、主动、长期、顾客价值、生成式学习

key_points.en: Gives an example such as the Post-it

model_answer.en: Market orientation is an organisation-wide habit of gathering information about customers, competitors and other market actors, sharing it across functions and acting on it together to deliver superior customer value. A customer-led firm follows expressed wants: it is responsive, short-term and aims at satisfaction, learning through surveys. A market-oriented firm also pursues latent needs customers cannot yet state: it is proactive, long-term and aims at customer value, learning through lead users and experiments. The Post-it began as a failed adhesive no customer would have requested.
model_answer.zh: 市场导向是全组织的习惯：收集顾客、竞争对手和其他市场参与者的信息，跨职能共享，并协同行动，交付更高的顾客价值。顾客牵着走的企业跟随明说的需求：响应式、短期、目标是满意度，靠问卷学习。市场导向的企业还追求顾客自己说不出的潜在需求：主动式、长期、目标是顾客价值，靠先锋用户和实验学习。便利贴起初是一种失败的胶水，没有顾客会提出要它。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain the difference between a customer-led and a market-oriented firm. (b) Using Coles in Australia, analyse how far it is market-oriented. (c) Make two recommendations.

Apply (10 marks). Exceeds: this company, rigorous cause and effect, evidence from the case. Meets: correct and logical, connections could go deeper.

Write the **Apply** part.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释“顾客牵着走”和“市场导向”企业的区别。(b) 以澳大利亚的 Coles 为例，分析它在多大程度上是市场导向。(c) 给出两条建议。

应用（10 分）。优秀：针对这家公司，因果分析严密，有案例证据。达标：应用正确、逻辑通顺，但联系还可以更深。

写**应用**部分。

key_points.en: Uses specific Coles facts, such as about 10.3 million active Flybuys members, online sales up 26.4% to 13.6% of supermarket sales, same-day delivery, exclusive partnerships
key_points.zh: 用 Coles 的具体事实，如约 1,030 万活跃 Flybuys 会员、线上销售增长 26.4% 并占超市销售 13.6%、当日送达、独家合作

key_points.en: Links facts to sensing, linking or bonding with a because
key_points.zh: 把事实联系到感知、联结或绑定，并有“因为”

key_points.en: Judges how far it is proactive rather than responsive, with reasons
key_points.zh: 判断它有多大程度是主动的而不只是响应式的，并给理由

key_points.en: Treats its own judgement as a reading
key_points.zh: 把自己的判断当作解读

model_answer.en: Coles shows strong sensing and linking. Its Flybuys programme, with about 10.3 million active members, gives continuous information on what shoppers buy, which supports market sensing, and the programme keeps shoppers tied to Coles, which is customer linking. Online sales rose 26.4% to 13.6% of supermarket sales, with same-day delivery from its fulfilment centres, because shoppers value time: that is responsive to a need already visible in behaviour. The proactive side is less visible. New exclusive partnerships with M&S, Grill’d and Gami add products shoppers did not have, and suggest Coles also looks for needs not yet stated, though this is my reading. Channel bonding appears in partnerships such as its expanded Uber Eats arrangement, tying a delivery partner to Coles’ offer. Overall, Coles looks market-oriented in sensing and linking and mainly responsive in innovation.
model_answer.zh: Coles 在感知和联结上很强。Flybuys 有约 1,030 万活跃会员，持续提供购物者买什么的信息，支持市场感知；这个计划把购物者和 Coles 绑在一起，就是顾客联结。线上销售增长 26.4%，占超市销售 13.6%，并用履约中心做当日送达，因为购物者看重时间：这是对行为里已经看得见的需求的响应。主动的一面不那么显眼。与 M&S、Grill’d、Gami 的新独家合作带来购物者以前没有的商品，说明 Coles 也在找尚未说出的需求，但这是我的解读。渠道绑定体现在扩大的 Uber Eats 合作等安排里，把送货伙伴绑进 Coles 的产品。总体看，Coles 在感知和联结上是市场导向，在创新上主要是响应式。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain the difference between a customer-led and a market-oriented firm. (b) Using Coles in Australia, analyse how far it is market-oriented. (c) Make two recommendations.

Recommend (5 marks). Exceeds: exactly two, realistic, strategic, actionable, each following from your analysis, with a risk named. Meets: sound but thin on how.

Write the **Recommend** part: exactly two.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释“顾客牵着走”和“市场导向”企业的区别。(b) 以澳大利亚的 Coles 为例，分析它在多大程度上是市场导向。(c) 给出两条建议。

建议（5 分）。优秀：恰好两条，现实、有战略性、可执行，都从你的分析里推出来，并点出风险。达标：合理，但“怎么做”偏薄。

写**建议**部分：恰好两条。

key_points.en: Exactly two, each following from the analysis (for example more proactive experimentation, or using Flybuys data to find latent needs)
key_points.zh: 恰好两条，各自从分析里推出（如更多主动实验，或用 Flybuys 数据找潜在需求）

key_points.en: Each says how it would be done
Names a risk or constraint, such as privacy or cost of experiments
key_points.zh: 点出风险或限制，如隐私或实验成本

model_answer.en: First, run small paid trials with lead users, such as shoppers who use delivery most, to test products they have not yet asked for, since the analysis showed Coles is strongest at sensing existing behaviour. The risk is cost and distraction from core operations, so trials should be small and time-limited. Second, use Flybuys purchase patterns to spot gaps between what members buy together and what Coles stocks, and pilot new exclusive items there with partners. This turns existing linking into proactive sensing; the risk is privacy, so it must use consented, aggregated data.
model_answer.zh: 第一，和先锋用户（如最常用送货的购物者）做小规模的付费试点，测试他们还没提出要的产品，因为分析显示 Coles 最强的是感知已有行为。风险是成本和分散对核心运营的注意力，所以试点要小、有期限。第二，用 Flybuys 购买模式找出会员常一起买的东西与 Coles 货架之间的缺口，和伙伴在那里试点新的独家商品。这把已有的联结变成主动的感知；风险是隐私，所以必须使用经同意、汇总过的数据。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。
